// diagnostic

E0636

`{name}` is a type, not a value

What

`{name}` is a type, not a value

Why

A type describes values but is not one; it has no value to bind, pass, return, store or print.

Fix

Build a value such as `{name}{…}`, or read a compile-time fact of the type, such as `{name}.reflect().fields`.
